description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales, 

Are delighted to present to you for sale this outstanding six-bedroom family residence, ideally located in the highly sought-after community of Corbally, just a twenty-minute drive from Galway City.

Extending to approximately 225 square metres of beautifully presented and intelligently designed living accommodation, this exceptional home sits on a magnificent 0.6-acre mature site, offering an ideal blend of space, privacy and convenience.

On arrival, you are greeted by beautifully maintained gardens with mature planting, colourful flower beds and generous green spaces that create a wonderful first impression. A bright and inviting glazed porch leads through to a spacious, light-filled entrance hallway that immediately sets the tone for the quality and scale of the accommodation that lies beyond.

To the right of the hallway is an elegant living room featuring a beautiful feature fireplace, an oversized front window that floods the room with natural light, and delightful views over the front gardens, creating a warm and welcoming space for family living.

To the rear of the home is the truly impressive open-plan kitchen and dining area. The contemporary kitchen is finished in a striking royal blue and is centred around a professional-style range cooker, making it the perfect space for both everyday family life and entertaining. An additional lounge area, complete with a feature solid fuel stove, creates a wonderfully relaxed atmosphere, while glazed patio doors open directly onto an extensive paved patio, seamlessly connecting the indoors with the beautifully landscaped rear garden and providing the ideal setting for alfresco dining during the warmer months.

Located just off the kitchen is a generously proportioned utility room, along with a convenient guest WC, providing all of the practical features expected of a modern family home.

The hallway leads to three exceptionally spacious double bedrooms, all offering outstanding proportions and oceans of floor space. 
Two of these bedrooms benefit from their own ensuite bathrooms, while a further room is currently arranged as a home gym but could equally serve as an additional bedroom, playroom or office. A beautifully appointed family bathroom completes the ground floor accommodation.

Upstairs, the property continues to impress with two exceptionally spacious double bedrooms positioned at opposite ends of the home. Both rooms are flooded with natural light from Velux windows and feature generous walk-in wardrobes, providing superb comfort and storage. A sixth bedroom, perfectly positioned between the two principal bedrooms, would make an ideal home office, study or nursery, making this an exceptional property for those working remotely or requiring multiple work-from-home spaces. A second family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation.

With six generously proportioned bedrooms, this remarkable home offers tremendous flexibility for modern family living, providing abundant space for home offices, guest accommodation, hobbies or growing families without compromise.

Externally, the mature rear gardens provide an idyllic haven for children to play, gardening enthusiasts to enjoy, or simply relaxing in complete privacy, all within one of Galway's most desirable and accessible residential settings.

If you are searching for an exceptionally spacious, cleverly designed and beautifully finished family residence that combines extensive accommodation, magnificent mature gardens and an easy commute to Galway City, then look no further than this outstanding home in Corbally. It is a property that effortlessly delivers on space, style, flexibility and location, and is certain to meet the needs of even the most discerning purchaser.

Call Fair Deal Property today to arrange your viewing. We'd be delighted to show you around this exceptional family home.
